kind: W2 data-directory containment and inherited-ACL observation on Windows
scope: Gateway started twice from the committed CLI (default random loopback listener, --mock); only file names and inherited ACL entries recorded; no token or key contents read or published
containmentDetail: Every run created control.json, gateway.lock, identity.key, mesh.sqlite, mesh.sqlite-shm and mesh.sqlite-wal strictly inside the explicitly selected private data directory; Node SQLite ran in WAL mode (shm/wal present alongside the database) and the same directories survived graceful shutdown

gracefulShutdown.portsReleased: verified (only transient TIME_WAIT sockets remained; no LISTEN entries)

conclusion: The Gateway adds no ACL entries of its own and never writes outside the selected directory; effective isolation is fully determined by the parent placement. On this specific host every checked placement (user temp, data-drive user directory, user profile) inherits entries that grant other ordinary users at least read access, including Everyone:Full from host policy. Recorded as a host constraint; not modified, no elevation and no firewall change performed. Operators should verify the chosen data-directory parent on production hosts.
status: containment verified; host-level ACL isolation not confirmed (host policy constraint, unchanged)
